papers.t: Stabilization of soil organic carbon in the alpine meadow is dependent on the nitrogen deposition level on the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau
Short-term P addition weakens the positive effects of N addition on CH4 uptake in alpine grasslands of the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau
P addition weakens the positive effects of N addition on CH4 uptake and does not affect the effects of N addition on CO2 emission in alpine grasslands
